definition: א , Aleph , first letter; in post Biblical Hebrew = numeral 1 (and so in margin of printed MT); א֟ = 1000; no evidence of this usage in OT times. אָב see II. אבה .
definition_html:
BDB1 [H0]

BDB10022 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB2

א, Aleph, first letter; in post Biblical Hebrew = numeral 1 (and so in margin of printed MT); א֟ = 1000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

אָב see II. אבה.
